How to read the counts

Facts match on field, raw value, assertion status and temporal context. Only the literal Medications: and Report: labels are stripped for comparison; dates, doses, units and negation are not guessed or normalized away. Duplicate predictions count as extras.

Findings match by packet, rule, kind and field. TP means matched, FP means unmatched prediction, and FN means missed annotation. Failed readable packets retain their missed facts and findings. Unsupported-input packets stay in the total and rejection counts.

Citation integrity checks source page, exact quote, code-point offsets and hash. Provisional support agreement also checks the annotated fact and supported span. It is not an independent human judgment. An annotation mismatch is not automatically a hallucination; missing citations, invalid citations, unsupported citations and values absent from source text are separate counters in the downloadable summary.

Fact-by-field and finding-by-kind denominators are included in the JSON. These small, regular synthetic examples do not measure performance on real referrals.
